digest.component_or_area: LLM model configuration and env-var deprecation registry
propositions: REBAR_LLM_MODEL is deprecated as a supersession (not a rename) and registered via _scheduled/_permanent in the deprecation REGISTRY, with the block comment about permanent-only entries corrected accordingly.
Within the deprecation window REBAR_LLM_MODEL still works and maps a single model to all three model classes, while explicit per-class config takes precedence.

A deprecation warning must fire at every env read of REBAR_LLM_MODEL — both config.py's from_env read and the new model_classes.py fan-out read — routed through warn_deprecated, warning when the variable is set even if a CLI --model overrides it.
A config-table model key or per-step model with REBAR_LLM_MODEL unset must emit no warning, forbidding placing the warning in resolve_model_string where provenance is lost.

Operator-visible references to REBAR_LLM_MODEL (help text, MCP tool description, docstrings, and six prose docs including README) must present class configuration instead and mark the env var deprecated.
Ship an ADR recording the class model, deprecation window, and rejected alternatives, plus four complete pasteable example configs (Anthropic-only, Bedrock-only, mixed-provider, local+fallback).
